camel_example: aliyun dataworks-public ListWorkflows --region cn-hangzhou --TriggerType Scheduler --Owner 1000 --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --SortBy Id_Desc --ProjectId 100 --Ids '[1234]' --EnvType Prod --Tags '["key:value"]' --Name Workflow1
description_en: Queries a list of workflows by page. You can also specify filter conditions to query workflows
description_zh: 分页获取工作流列表，也可以通过条件进行筛选查询
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public list-workflows --project-id 100 --env-type Prod --ids 1234 --name Workflow1 --owner 1000 --trigger-type Scheduler --sort-by Id_Desc --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --tags key:value --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListWorkflows

parameters.help_en:
The environment of the workspace. Valid values:

- Prod: production environment

- Dev: development environment
parameters.help_zh:
项目环境。
- Prod：生产
- Dev：开发
parameters.name: env_type

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the workflows. You can query multiple workflows at a time by workflow ID
parameters.help_zh: 工作流ID列表，可根据工作流Id批量查询多个工作流信息
parameters.name: ids

parameters.help_en: The name of the workflow. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The account ID of the workflow owner
parameters.name: owner

parameters.help_en:
The trigger type.

- Scheduler

- Manual

- TriggerWorkflow
parameters.help_zh:
触发方式类型。
- Scheduler
- Manual
- TriggerWorkflow
parameters.name: trigger_type

parameters.help_en:
The field used for sorting. Fields such as TriggerTime and StartedTime are supported. The value of this parameter is in the Sort field + Sort by (Desc/Asc) format. By default, results are sorted in ascending order. Valid values:

- ModifyTime (Desc/Asc)

- CreateTime (Desc/Asc)

- Id (Desc/Asc)

Default value: Id Desc
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段。支持修改时间、创建时间等字段，格式为"排序字段+排序方式(Desc/Asc)"（Asc可以缺省）。排序字段的枚举值如下：
- ModifyTime (Desc/Asc)
- CreateTime (Desc/Asc)
- Id (Desc/Asc)

默认值：Id Desc
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: List of tags. A result is returned if it matches any one of the specified tags
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表，多个标签中满足一个即会返回结果
parameters.name: tags
